title: Engine adapter: Tiny-Jev (Qwen3-0.6B, transformers)
description: Apache-2.0, probabilities per option, MPS 20 to 50 ms per text, CPU and CUDA. No pip package; load with transformers.

comments.author: home
comments.text:
Feature: Engine adapter: Tiny-Jev answers a scored task

Scenario: Tiny-Jev returns option probabilities without a pip package
  Given the Tiny-Jev (Qwen3-0.6B, Apache-2.0) model loadable with transformers on MPS, CPU or CUDA
  When I run bd run --engine tiny-jev on a committed task
  Then it returns a probability per option for every item and studies/ records the answers

right_now_summary: Tiny-Jev is being added as a Transformers adapter that scores options on MPS, CPU, and CUDA.
